models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses:
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors faulty
Water damage at connector
Transmission Vehicle Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G38) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors

Kontrol edin:  Transmission Vehicle Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G38)
See Measuring Value Blocks (MVB)
technicalNotes:
When found in the 4-Speed Automatic Transmission (01M) transmission:
Kontrol edin:  for any applicable TSBs for overlay wiring harnesses as mentioned on the 01M page.
The terminal connectors for the G38 and G68 are the same and can be mixed up.  This can give an "Implausible Signal".  Verify sensors have the correct connectors using the wiring diagram and TSBs mentioned on the 01M page.
